title: Confidence grade: pair count and reading age, lower wins
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin (Settings Service), on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on (behind the maintenance_reminders flag). These are numeric/date-accuracy cases (Rule 116): seed the exact inputs, read the produced value back, and compare it to the stated value - never eyeball, never accept "a number".
  2. An enrolled unit with a meter-driven service, seeded with reading histories to hit each band. Usable pairs are consecutive readings that survive the guards; a discarded pair drops the count. Compute each expected grade by hand first.
custom_steps:
1. Seed a clean history of 2 visits (1 pair) with a recent last reading and read the grade; then 3 visits (2 pairs); 4 visits (3 pairs); 5 visits (4 pairs).
  2. Seed a unit with no usable pair and read the state.
  3. Hold the count at 5+ visits and set the last recorded reading to 60, then 120, then 200 days old; read the grade each time.
  4. Seed 5 visits where one pair is discarded by a guard and read the grade.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • By usable-pair count (clean history): none = No data, 1 pair (2 visits) = Low, 2-3 pairs (3-4 visits) = Medium, 4+ pairs (5+ visits) = High.
  • By last-reading age: <=90 days keeps the count grade; 91-180 caps at Medium; 181+ caps at Low - so a High-by-count unit reads High at 60 days, Medium at 120, Low at 200.
  • Confidence is the lower of the two; a discarded pair drops the count, so 5 visits with one bad pair = 3 pairs = Medium.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780; Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), the confidence matrix (S11-R22/R23/R24/R25/E5), reproduced in the spec as the basis for the S9 asset-tab and S13 worklist confidence display; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S11-R22: “Confidence is set by two inputs, graded separately, and the lower of the two wins: how many usable readings the unit has, and how old the last recorded one is”
  • S11-R23: “By count of usable pairs ... none is No data; one is Low; two or three is Medium; four or more is High. In a clean history that is two visits for Low, three or four for Medium and five or more for High. Where a guard discards a pair the count drops with it, so a unit with five visits and one bad pair has three pairs and reads Medium”
  • S11-R24: “By age of the most recent recorded reading, by date: up to and including 90 days leaves the grade where the count put it; from 91 to 180 days caps it at Medium; 181 days or more caps it at Low”
